findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "recommend_allocation" appears informational but accepts parameters (context) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_robinhood_whale_prints, get_launchpad_radar, inspect_onchain · Private data: get_robinhood_whale_prints, check_token_safety, get_analyst_accuracy, get_smart_money_inflow, get_social_hype, get_launchpad_radar, forecast_chart, analyze_token_security, inspect_onchain, analyze_wallet, analyze_tokenized_stocks, detect_mev, scan_launchpads, analyze_bitcoin, generate_quantum_key, find_yield, check_content_integrity · Public sink: get_launchpad_radar, scan_v4_hooks, inspect_onchain, generate_quantum_key · Destructive: get_price_forecast, run_backtest.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_robinhood_whale_prints, get_launchpad_radar, inspect_onchain · Private data: get_robinhood_whale_prints, check_token_safety, get_analyst_accuracy, get_smart_money_inflow, get_social_hype, get_launchpad_radar, forecast_chart, analyze_token_security, inspect_onchain, analyze_wallet, analyze_tokenized_stocks, detect_mev, scan_launchpads, analyze_bitcoin, generate_quantum_key, find_yield, check_content_integrity · Public sink: get_launchpad_radar, scan_v4_hooks, inspect_onchain, generate_quantum_key · Destructive: get_price_forecast, run_backtest

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "forecast_chart" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
